capabilities.window_observations: Read-only list_game_windows includes PID, process birth/path, native client and screen bounds, foreground identities, UTC and monotonic timestamps; unavailable process data is explicit. New window_observations samples foreground for 0â€“10000 ms at requested 100â€“2000 ms intervals, plus inventories before/after. No session token, focus, selection, screenshots or input. capabilities.capture: observe_game and capture_after return a PNG plus identity/geometry/timing receipt. Physical-monitor clipping preserves client canvas positions as black padding, with clipped/incomplete/missing_native_pixels/visible_client_regions and exact image_to_client_scale. capabilities.cloud_queue: Window inventory/sampling may overlap launch/control. A second control action remains excluded; normal calls leave a coordination slot within the companion's four-command limit.
capabilities.connection_diagnostics: Existing connection_status now reports PC/companion/backend identity/version/PIDs, server contact timestamps/age and diagnostic next steps. Its input snapshot is explicitly scoped to the paired backend while nested control_session describes the desktop-wide owner; snapshots never reserve control. Idle cloud reports every15s, observed changes sooner;45s is stale, native tray remains3s. Error/absent samples retain the older input timestamp and mark it not fresh. SQLite retains one bounded last connection record, written on ready/close/adoption; live hibernation attachments retain heartbeats. Old socket closes cannot replace a new connection. Private tokens, tool arguments and credentials are excluded. Last-reported pause/stop/reconnect and historical PC retry failures are separated from unknown current offline cause. Timeout/disconnect do not claim cleanup completion.
capabilities.close_game: Owning session plus explicit fresh HWND/PID/process birth/path/class. Query/synchronize process handle stays pinned; critical/unverifiable or different-session processes reject. Neutralize input before WM_CLOSE without activation; bounded 0-10000ms grace. Separate window/process/timeout/identity/cancel results with UTC/monotonic boundaries. Default never kills. Force only on explicit human request, through original pinned process while original window still matches, then up to 2000ms exit wait. No launcher/child/tree targeting. Window loss, identity change, cancellation, expiry or F12 prevents later force; posted close cannot be recalled. Pinning prevents PID reuse retargeting; Windows identity check and HWND message post are separate operations, not an atomic guarantee against concurrent HWND replacement.
capabilities.camera_recipes: prepare_camera_recipe is read-only and resolves one-axis angular phases from caller-supplied signed measurements/evidence and settings/build/binding context. Require distinct bidirectional evidence; reject stationary/nonfinite/inconsistent response and extrapolation beyond measured duration/speed/deflection ranges. Before/motion/after phases, neutral outside motion, max30s. play_camera_recipe requires owning lease and matching selected process/window/client dimensions, foreground and device type. Mouse or right-stick axes only; no movement keys/buttons/left stick/triggers. It does not reset starting camera pose or scene. Digest checks exact recipe. Retained duplicate run ID returns cached receipt without replay; history is8 in-memory runs per backend, lost on restart/eviction. camera_run_status reads partial receipts during replay without reserving control.
capabilities.camera_provenance: Requested/sent counts, acknowledged state transition bounds, per-phase timing/error, sampled guard checks/gaps, run/session/phase/target identity and neutral attempt receipts. Camera scheduling and delivery monotonic_ns fields use python.time.perf_counter, observed QueryPerformanceCounter resolution1e-7s; clock domain and bracketing correlation to python.time.monotonic window-observation timestamps are included. Do not compare clock domains directly or infer game polling/render time from API receipts. Actual stop conditions are read directly; mutable display text is not a cause signal. game_motion_verified and comparison_ready remain false with missing-measurement flags; no stationary/missing data is accepted as motion or performance success.
